information.description:
Caged in Japan for forty-five years, Arasaka could only reach the world through people who didn't officially exist. The Fuma was built for them. It passes for a tired salaryman on the train, and a minute later it isn't there at all. Arasaka has never listed it in a catalog, and this entry comes from a Night Market seller who wouldn't give a name.

Cost: 28,700eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 58 ([1d6/2] + 17d6)
Frame: Beta (14): BODY 14
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Base chrome (no HL): FBC Gemini Sculpt
Chrome: FBC Chameleon Coating ×2, Internal Hydraulics Upgrade (Tuned), Kairos 6-M, Low Light/Infrared/UV ×2, Lynx Paws, Monowire, Optical Camo, Scrambler/Descrambler, Subdermal Pocket ×2, Synaptic Accelerator

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.
